title: How to polish locomotion?
author: chmillout
selftext:
Hey everyone, I noticed that creating quick cool prototypes with almost any model is pretty easy and mindblowingly fast but polishing is a nightmare. Any tips how to improve the smoothness of animations, blending, logics?

I’ve experimenting with different LLMs to create this “advanced locomotion” for around a month already and still can’t get it smooth enough, still all kinds of random glitches appear here and there and it is so frustrating to explain what to fix to Claude or Devin or Codex. They fix one thing but break another in a never ending loop. It’s like these 10% that are left to finally get the locomotion just right are the hardest.

Do you have any pipelines or prompts or advices how to make LLMs plan out the animation speeds, blendings, smoothness and for example make sure the hands grab exactly ledges and not the air for the ledge grabs? You can see that legs and hands are constantly clipping through surfaces. 

You can test this prototype on itch - https://chmillout.itch.io/aeonsparadise

It’s mobile friendly so you can play from your smartphone in portrait mode.

Any kinds of advices would be appreciated greatly!

P.S. Yes I did use Astra but it burns all my credits in 5 minutes and doesn’t even ends a task, it’s ridiculous.
